message.content: {"thought": "The operator group analysis confirms: FFN dominates latency (91.4B out of ~153.5B total, ~60%) and is purely compute-bound (100% calc_time, negligible noc/dram). Attention is second (61.9B, ~40%) also compute-dominant. The 'other' group (norm2, res2, res1) has tiny latency (11.9M) but is memory/communication-bound (noc_time 9.5M, dram_time 11.5M vs calc_time 57K). This confirms the bottleneck state: the critical path is dominated by compute-bound FFN layers, with a small memory/communication tail. Since compute_units is already at max (16384), the remaining compute levers are: buffer_size (8192->32768 could enable better tiling), chiplet_type (ws->os could change dataflow), or micro_batch (2->4 could increase parallelism). Let me check the monetary cost breakdown to understand cost structure before proposing a change.", "action": "tool", "tool": {"name": "summarize_monetary_cost", "arguments": {"top_components": 8}}}
